invariants.rationale: A well-formed public API should never return null for a collection, and the implementation always returns the result of postWrite, which should not be null.
The incoming list of records to insert should not be null, as all processing uses this parameter.
The instantTime parameter is propagated and used throughout the method, so it should be non-null at return.
If no WriteStatus objects are returned, it is likely that there were no records to write.
Each WriteStatus corresponds to a write operation, so the number of WriteStatus objects should not exceed the number of input records.
